title: Single-element cantilever column buckling
geometry: 2 nodes; 1 elements. One CBAR of length 10; E=1e7, A=0.5, I1=1/24, I2=104.16666666667.
material: E=1e+07, nu=0.33; density=0.1. Consistent benchmark units; displacements in deck length unit, forces in deck force unit, stress in force/length^2
boundary_conditions: All 6 DOFs at root GRID 1 fixed using permanent GRID constraints; unit axial compressive end force.
loading: Unit axial compressive tip force; Euler comparison uses the weak-axis second moment of area.

references.citation: MYSTRAN open-source test input provenance (MIT license); stored historical output values are regression targets only.

observations: Actual shipped mesh has one beam element. Euler value is the independent continuum target; finite-mesh error is retained.
limits: Linear elasticity and small-displacement equilibrium or linearized bifurcation/modal analysis; this is computational verification, not a material-test validation.
figure_caption: Recorded JFEM result; deformation is amplified, mode amplitudes/signs arbitrary. Green triangles mark constrained nodes; magenta arrows mark available point loads.
